title: This Super-Bright Security Camera Is at Its Cheapest Price Ever!
summary: Have you ever wished you had a superhero guard for your house? The Eufy E340 Floodlight Camera is kind of like that—but it's a camera with two super-bright lights! It just hit its lowest price ever, so let's peek at what makes it cool. Most outdoor cameras have a tiny spotlight, but this one has two big light panels that pump out 2,000 lumens. That's bright enough to turn your dark backyard into daytime. You can even tilt the panels to aim the light where you want. The camera has a secret weapon: two lenses! One wide-angle lens sees the big picture, and a telephoto lens zooms in up to 8X. It can read a license plate or spot a face from 50 feet away—in full color, even at night. And it moves! The camera spins 360 degrees and tilts 120 degrees, and it can automatically follow a person or pet walking by. When they leave, it goes back to its starting spot. The best part? No monthly fees. You just pop in a microSD card (up to 128 GB) and it records right there. If a sneaky raccoon or a package thief shows up, you'll get an alert on your phone. It even has a loud 95-decibel siren—as loud as a motorcycle! The only catch: it needs to be plugged in, so you might need a grown-up to help set it up. But once it's running, it's like having a watchful, bright-eyed robot guarding your home.
why_it_matters: This camera helps families feel safe at home, just like a nightlight or a watchful guard, showing how technology can make everyday life more secure for kids and pets.

Article_Structure: WHO: The Eufy E340 Floodlight Camera.
WHAT: A feature-packed security camera with dual lights, two lenses, and 360-degree motion tracking, now at its lowest price.
WHERE: It can be set up outside any home that has a power outlet.
WHY: Because it offers bright lighting, clear zoom, automatic tracking, and no monthly fees, making it an attractive option for home safety.
